## Quick start: simulate → fit → predict → plot

```r
library(joinme)

set.seed(2026)

# Simulate a small dataset
sim <- simulate_joinme_joint_student_t_cvtotal(
  n_id = 10,
  D = 2,
  n_t = 4,
  seed = 2026,
  include_marker_only = TRUE
)

formulaLong <- y ~ 1 + time + x1 +
  (1 + time | id) +
  (0 + x1 + (1 + time | id) | marker)

formulaEvent <- survival::Surv(time, event) ~ 1 + x1 + x2

fit <- joinme(
  formulaLong = formulaLong,
  dataLong = sim$dataLong,
  formulaEvent = formulaEvent,
  dataEvent = sim$dataEvent,
  assoc = c("cv_total"),
  families = rep("student_t", 2),
  transforms = list(cv_total = list(type = "identity")),
  control = list(
    parallel_chains = 1,
    iter_warmup = 100,
    iter_sampling = 100,
    seed = 2026,
    refresh = 0,
    adapt_delta = 0.9
  )
)

# Summaries
summary(fit)
fixef(fit)

# Dynamic prediction for one subject
ndL <- sim$dataLong[sim$dataLong$id == 1, ]
ndE <- sim$dataEvent[sim$dataEvent$id == 1, ]
Tstart <- max(ndL$time)

pred <- posterior_epred(
  fit,
  newdataLong = ndL,
  newdataEvent = ndE,
  Tstart = Tstart,
  times = seq(Tstart, Tstart + 1, length.out = 20),
  n_samples = 50,
  seed = 2026
)

# Plot longitudinal and survival predictions
plot(pred)
```
